why: The failure-channel split is about who is at fault, and it turns on the shape. An error *object* is the provider reporting a failure in its own grammar, which is the event channel (fixture 05). A `false` — or a string, a number, an array — under `/error` is not a failure report at all; it is a document this decoder does not know. Admitting it would let any wrong-typed field seal a stream as provider-declared failure, which reads in a receipt as 'the provider said it failed' when nobody said anything of the kind.
